_about: Copy rules for meringominutes.app, checked by tools/check.py. Each rule names why it exists. The copy speaks as Adam, first person singular; text inside data-lint="app" is the app's own words and is exempt from the voice rules only.
csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; media-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'

banned.why: Nothing is encrypted at rest; never imply it.
Absence of a bot is privacy, never concealment; use an allowed phrase.
There is no sandbox; nothing is structurally enforced.
Placement accuracy is not measured to that standard.
No users or testimonials exist to cite.

voice.why: The site speaks as Adam, first person singular.

allowed_phrases.why: An honest absence: nothing joins the call.

allowed_phrases.phrase: the app adds no encryption of its own
allowed_phrases.why: /privacy/ says plainly that meetings are stored as ordinary files; the negation is the point.

allowed_phrases.phrase: The audio and the transcript stay stored on your Mac
allowed_phrases.why: FAQ F09 is about pointing the summariser at another machine; this sentence says what stays put when you do. The library is one folder on the Mac whatever the summariser setting, so it needs no "by default".

digits.why: Every number on the site has a source. A digit in visible copy must sit in a <span data-fact> whose text equals its value in data/facts.json, a <time>, the app's own quoted words (data-lint="app") or the footer.

allowed.why: A quarter's name, quoted from the demo meeting ("end of Q3").
The not-found page naming its own HTTP status, not a claim.
Audio file formats named in the FAQ (F37), not figures.

locality.pattern: (on|from) your (own )?mac|never leaves|leaves your mac|stays on your mac|on this mac|on your own machine
locality.why: Locality is the default, not an invariant: the summariser can be pointed at another machine.

_forbidden_token_note: SHA-256 of lowercase tokens that must never appear in any tracked file (the checking model's name). Stored as hashes so this public repo does not publish the name it forbids.
